steps.comment: hot_path_profile's scene exactly (six linked stoves, six colonists, potatoes on the floor, power), with the group switched to the stock-aware state instead of round robin. Run it beside hot_path_profile on the same build: the difference is the cost of the urgency sort and its count cache. Everything before the Profile step exists to make the work-giver actually run. Previous profiled windows were PAUSED for every frame, so the two patches that fire per bench per pawn per scan — the JobOnThing prefix and the ShouldDoNow postfix — were measured only as the bill tab redrawing them, which is not where they are hot.
Six stoves rather than two: the JobOnThing prefix runs once per bench per scanning pawn, so bench count is one of the two multipliers in its real cost.
Powered, or every bench fails UsableForBillsAfterFueling and the work giver returns before reaching our prefix — which would measure the guard clause rather than the path.

The solar generator above is never wired, so every stove reported 'Not connected to power' and no one cooked: the prefixes ran, but vanilla's JobOnThing returned before walking a single bill and the stock never moved. Spotted by eye on the capture. Two toxifier generators (no fuel, 1400 W each, against six 350 W stoves and a night that zeroes the solar) and a conduit run along z=4, within vanilla's 6-cell connection range of every stove (a south run was tried and four of its cells sit on an unbuildable blocker in the fixture), fix it; wbg_benches_powered asserts it rather than trusting the layout.

Without ingredients the bills are never startable: TryFindBestBillIngredients fails, sets nextTickToSearchForIngredients, and the work giver skips the bill for ten seconds. The first run of this scenario measured 26 ShouldDoNow calls in two seconds for exactly that reason — a table of near-zeroes that says nothing about the hot path.
The other multiplier. The fixture colony has one able colonist, so pawns for this have to be spawned; player faction so they are given work.

The stock-aware state under measurement: Balance plus 'one of each first', so every sort computes both tiers and the ratio, and every bill takes vanilla's slow, map-wide CountProducts (slowCount) — the path the 60-tick count cache exists to bound.

The measurement. timeSpeed is explicit because the default of leaving the scenario's speed is what produced PausedFrames == every frame before; warmupFrames keeps the analyzer's own JIT of each rewritten method out of the first sample.

Labels include ':Prefix' because the analyzer matches by substring, and the urgency sort's sibling patch class shares this one's name as a prefix — the bare class name matched both rows and the assert refused to pick.
After the window: PowerOn is only set by a power-net tick, and the scenario is paused until Profile.
1 to 6 pawns on the group's bills, or the window measured an idle scene.
Evidence the scene worked rather than idled: pawns at powered stoves with meals on the floor.
